steps.title: JVP rule: forward-mode derivative
steps.code:
def _jvp(primals, tangents):
    x, y, z = primals
    xt, yt, zt = (ad.instantiate_zeros(t) for t in tangents)
    out = multiply_add(x, y, z)
    t_out = multiply_add(xt, y, multiply_add(x, yt, zt))   # linear in the tangents
    return out, t_out

ad.primitive_jvps[multiply_add_p] = _jvp

def _batch(args, dims):                 # dims[i]: which axis of args[i] is the batch, or None
    # move batch axes to the front; unbatched operands get a leading axis of 1
    moved = [front_or_expand(a, d) for a, d in zip(args, dims)]
    return multiply_add(*moved), 0       # the output's batch axis is 0

batching.primitive_batchers[multiply_add_p] = _batch
